recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Body: Kyle and Serena Denton are community herbalists creating wild-crafted and organic plant medicines out of Milwaukee since 2015. These products work—not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Minimalism and detox in Mike's routine", "body": "Asked about his nutrition and supplementation, Mike Winner says his strategy has gone completely minimalist, arguing that consciousness matters more than anything we put in our bodies and that a toxic environment makes detox his main focus. He walks through his morning: rising early for sun gazing during yoga and qigong, a tonic of Smith River structured water with lemon, and Alfa Vedic's fulvic mineral liquid, then one meal a day, a habit he credits to Dr. Barre Lando. For Mike, simple daily ritual is how we reconnect to source instead of getting lost in complexity, and Chance later agrees detoxing may matter most."}, {"title": "Terrain versus germ theory, in Mike's view", "body": "Chance opens the germ theory question by linking the idea of a hostile, infectious universe to a pop culture Gnostic belief that nature is a prison and the body is base. Mike calls modern science scientism, a materialist religion, and retells the Alfa Cast story of Antoine Béchamp's inner terrain versus Louis Pasteur, whom he casts as a jealous politician whose single-microbe model fed what he calls Rockefeller medicine and a war on microbes. Chance wonders whether belief in an external germ, or a transmissible vibe, helps people get sick, and Mike points to Dr. Hamer's New German Medicine and the body as a biocomputer."}, {"title": "Karma, redemption and the afterlife", "body": "Chance shares an insight from the Gene Keys reading of the I Ching's 22nd hexagram, grace, suggesting karma may be wiped clean each lifetime rather than punished in the next. Mike, a volunteer firefighter who asks why bad things happen to good people, would rather believe in a karmic wheel, citing Edgar Cayce. Chance offers a middle path: an astral life review where even the worst souls face what they caused, since consciousness is the light that clears darkness, and he reframes hard lives as older souls choosing deeper compassion. Mike recalls a hitman's near-death redemption and a UCLA parapsychology club's astral projection experiments."}, {"title": "A mental universe we shape together", "body": "Mike credits David Icke's The Biggest Secret with sparking his awakening around 2000, when he read it on lunch breaks while selling shoes at Nordstrom. Drawing on Walter Russell, he describes reality as a mental construct of the universal one: each of us masters our own reality, yet we create this plastic realm together. A friend's dream of Icke and a horse stopping at a torn-down electric fence becomes his metaphor for self-imposed limits, and he calls leaving victim consciousness the key work now, citing Dean Radin's psi research. Chance, recalling his treasure-hunter father's intuition, argues the only real warfare is worldview warfare, shaping how we see our ancestors."}, {"title": "Sovereignty through Qortal and Music and Sky", "body": "Mike's passion for economics and value systems leads to Qortal, a decentralized network he says is rebuilding the internet outside fiat-based exchanges, with decentralized groups that turn into real-world meetups and a food-backed coin in development with food forest grower Jim Gale. Chance notes Mike was the first guest to break down crypto on Higher Side Chats. The Music and Sky festival, started by burners disillusioned with Burning Man and people seeking connection during the pandemic, is what Mike calls his biggest passion: family focused, centered on ice baths, workshops and a 24-hour art gallery, because he believes culture grounded in sovereignty is how movements form."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Mike Winner is the host of the legendary Alfa Cast along with Dr. Barre Lando. From the remote shores of the Smith River in the rural Pacific Northwest, Mike and Barre are cultivating a biodynamic ecosystem, creating online events and offline gatherings, bringing together the knowledge to build a better society, and the right people to utilize it.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension we discuss the Music & Sky Festival, 90's rave culture, the spiritual analogue to technological advancements, cannabis lessons, crypto and the Qortal Project, privacy & sovereignty, and a lot more.
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I think it's important right now for us to simplify and get more minimal with our approach to our health, because really we have an inherent zero point machine of consciousness.", "author": "Mike Winner", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e0d9730-f79f-4740-9294-454b580e6056/MIKE-WINNER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Consciousness is the light that shines on the darkness and clears it, so that means you have to become aware of it and you have to feel it.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "What I call scientism, or what traditionally is known as science today, is a religion of our time, and it is based on pure materialism.", "author": "Mike Winner", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e0d9730-f79f-4740-9294-454b580e6056/MIKE-WINNER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "We could reframe a difficult life situation as being a more advanced and older soul coming in to experience something that requires even more compassion to level up.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "You of course are the master of your own reality, but also we're all in this together. We all create this realm together.", "author": "Mike Winner", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e0d9730-f79f-4740-9294-454b580e6056/MIKE-WINNER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The only warfare that exists in the world is worldview warfare, because that's what allows the world to be shaped into the semblance of a prison planet.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "We are the divine creators of our reality, and it's really where we put our attention is what matters most.", "author": "Mike Winner", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e0d9730-f79f-4740-9294-454b580e6056/MIKE-WINNER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "We are in a conversation with archetypes at all times, and our perspective on the archetypes and on life changes the archetypes as much as their communication to us changes us.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "We believe art and culture and entertainment needs to be grounded in sovereignty, because that's how movements form.", "author": "Mike Winner", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e0d9730-f79f-4740-9294-454b580e6056/MIKE-WINNER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "This idea of us even being a savior of others plays right into victim consciousness.", "author": "Mike Winner", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e0d9730-f79f-4740-9294-454b580e6056/MIKE-WINNER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
